span.p:
⓪ ACTIVE PERCEPTION · camera check before each move
light, blur, full body, distance, view angle
→ tells the user how to fix the phone; starts only when it can judge

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
① PERCEIVE · OpenCV 5
pose → faults (hips_low, knees_down…)
+ which exercise this looks like

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Clearly a different
exercise for ~2.4 s?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Say so; ask:
'Should I coach it as a plank?'
